retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait in a narrow, gritty industrial stairwell featuring high-contrast yellow condensed typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a patchwork denim jacket stands centrally in a dark, weathered concrete stairwell, leaning on handrails. The composition is framed by the narrow walls, with vibrant yellow, ultra-condensed sans-serif text positioned at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a narrow vertical architectural frame
High-contrast yellow typography against a dark, desaturated background
Textural contrast between denim fabric and weathered concrete walls
Symmetrical handrail placement leading the eye toward the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait, centered, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large yellow text, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the arms out to the handrails.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas of the stairwell surrounding the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated blues and grays (denim and concrete)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the yellow text and the dark background; low saturation in the environment.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same color, contrasting widths (ultra-condensed vs. wide tracking).
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, tall sans-serif aesthetic.
Provides a similar clean, impactful uppercase look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a patchwork denim jacket and baseball cap, standing in a dark, gritty, narrow concrete stairwell with industrial handrails. The lighting should be moody and focused on the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered yellow text at the top. The first line should be in an ultra-condensed tall sans-serif. The second line should be smaller with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the main text ultra-condensed and yellow?
Is the subject centered in a narrow industrial space?
Is the overall color palette dominated by blue, gray, and yellow?

adjustableVariables: Level of grit/texture on the walls
Subject's clothing style (while maintaining denim/workwear theme)
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact patchwork pattern on the jacket
Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Clashing neon colors other than yellow

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is not obscured by the background.
Ensure the stairwell walls create a natural frame for the subject.
Verify the 'Parental Advisory' style block is in the bottom right if requested.
Confirm the typography maintains a tall, condensed profile.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Yellow Type + Symmetrical Framing
